name: 2D platformer
core_loop: Run right and read the tiles ahead
Time the jump over the hazard or onto the spring
Stomp or dodge the patrolling enemy
Bank the coins and reach the flag

questions.question: How much enemy pressure should the course carry?
Which tile theme should the first world use?

acceptance.promise: Tapping jump gives a short hop and holding it gives the full arc.
setup: Load the first course at the spawn tile
Freeze enemies so only the player moves
probes: Tap jump for one frame and record the apex
Hold jump to the top of the arc and record the apex
Step off a ledge and jump inside the coyote window
evidence: The tapped apex is strictly lower than the held apex
The held apex matches jump_velocity and gravity within tolerance
The coyote jump succeeds inside coyote_time and fails after it

acceptance.promise: Each death spends one life and the run ends at zero.
setup: Set lives to its authored value
Place a hazard directly under the spawn
probes: Kill the player once and read the HUD life count
Repeat until the count reaches zero
Read the run result after the final death
evidence: The HUD life count decreases by exactly one per death
The run result is a loss on the death that reaches zero
No respawn happens after the run result is raised
